liveSmokeScope: Owner-controlled test route: current availability, verified link, create, change, cancel and own-bookings; Spanish create/change and English cancel. Not exhaustive live security, provider-failure or production validation.

observations.evidence: Owner supplied received alternatives for all three categories, two nights, and current structured prices.
Owner sent the one-use command; same authenticated customer browser confirmed the pending link.
Owner supplied CREATE_COMPLETED WhatsApp reply and subsequent own-bookings reply. Independently observed identical stay in customer browser.
Browser calendar independently showed Suite nights October 25 and 26 occupied, October 27 free, matching the confirmed half-open stay.
After the original fifteen-minute session expired, WhatsApp denied a new private change request and requested login/linkage. Persisted stay remained visible after fresh login.
Fresh customer login, new one-use code and same-session browser confirmation restored linked authority without resetting the stay.

Owner supplied the unexecuted proposal, explicit confirmation and Dates updated reply via WhatsApp. Own bookings matched. Browser independently showed the new dates, original nights free and October 28/29 occupied.
Owner combined /en and the change request in one message. Booking intent was recognized, but language remained Spanish. Sending /en separately later changed the response language to English.

Owner supplied English cancellation proposal, explicit offer-bound confirmation, Booking cancelled reply and own-bookings response. Browser independently showed Cancelled, preserved dates/amount/history and released both Suite nights.

An initial mistyped non-hexadecimal stay reference returned the public help response, with no cancellation proposal. The correctly copied reference then produced a proposal; execution followed only its explicit confirmation.
